nodes.text: 6 . 1 Submissions and the inbox
nodes.zh: 6.1 提交项与收件箱

nodes.text: Every message is committed the moment you send it; a busy conversation queues it, and a boundary decides when it lands.
nodes.zh: 每条消息在你发出的瞬间就被提交；会话繁忙时它会排队，由一个边界决定它何时落地。

nodes.text: A user types a second message while the agent is still answering the first. Should it interrupt, wait, or be refused? And if the process dies a second later, is the message lost? Pi Durable answers with one rule: a message is committed before anything else happens to it. A commit is an atomic save: everything in it is stored together, or nothing is. After this section you can predict what happens to a message sent at any moment, and choose how a busy conversation should treat it.
nodes.zh: 用户在智能体还在回答第一条消息时又打了第二条。它该打断、等待，还是被拒绝？如果进程下一秒就死了，这条消息会丢吗？Pi Durable 用一条规则回答：一条消息在被做任何其他事情之前就已提交。一次提交是一次原子保存：其中的内容要么一起存下，要么都不存。读完本节，你就能预测在任意时刻发出的消息会遭遇什么，并选择繁忙的会话该怎样对待它。

nodes.text: Two kinds of submission
nodes.zh: 提交项的两种

nodes.text: A submission is the durable record of something you handed a conversation. There are two kinds. An input is a user message; it may start a run, the model calls and tool calls that answer it. A write adds an entry to the transcript without asking the model anything, such as a note from your app. Conversation.submit() writes the record in one commit and returns a Submission handle. The handle has status(), wait() and abort().
nodes.zh: 提交项是你交给某个会话的东西的持久记录。它有两种。输入是一条用户消息；它可能开启一次运行，以及为回答它而进行的模型调用和工具调用。写入是不向模型问任何问题、就往记录里加一个条目，比如来自你应用的一条备注。`Conversation.submit()` 用一次提交写下这条记录，并返回一个提交项句柄。句柄上有 `status()`、`wait()` 和 `abort()`。

nodes.text: Where a submission goes
nodes.zh: 提交项的去向

nodes.text: A submission is in one of four states. It is queued while it waits. An input is placed once its message is in the transcript and a run is answering it. It is done when it has its entry and, for an input, the answer. It is unanswered when it ended without one; a reason says why. wait() resolves only at done or unanswered.
nodes.zh: 提交项处于四种状态之一。等待期间它是 queued。输入一旦消息进入记录、且有一次运行正在回答它，就变成 placed。有了自己的条目——对输入来说还有了答案——就是 done。结束时没有答案就是 unanswered；reason 说明原因。`wait()` 只在 done 或 unanswered 时兑现。

nodes.text: The inbox
nodes.zh: 收件箱

nodes.text: Queued submissions wait in pi.inbox, a small built-in document, one per conversation (the built-in documents (p. 60)); a fork starts with an empty one. Each item has a mode that says when it may land. steer — “tell the agent as soon as its current tool calls finish”. The message joins the run in progress. followUp — “handle this after the current answer”. The message starts the next run. This is the default whenBusy. write — a queued write. It lands at the next chance, before any user message.
nodes.zh: 排队的提交项在 `pi.inbox` 里等待，它是一个小型内置文档，每个会话一个（内置文档（p. 60））；分叉开始时它为空。每个项都有一个 mode，说明它可以何时落地。`steer`——「在智能体当前的工具调用一结束就告诉它」。这条消息加入正在进行的运行。`followUp`——「在当前回答之后处理这个」。这条消息开启下一次运行。这是默认的 `whenBusy`。`write`——一项排队的写入。它在下一个机会落地，早于任何用户消息。

nodes.text: A boundary is the commit in which queued items enter the transcript. There are two. A postTools boundary runs after a round of tool calls when the run is going on. A final boundary runs when a run ends successfully.

nodes.text: Withdrawal, failure and crashes
nodes.zh: 撤回、失败与崩溃

nodes.text: Submission.abort() withdraws a submission that is still queued. It settles as unanswered with reason aborted, and the call returns "aborted". Once placed it is too late: the call returns "already_placed", or "settled" if it has already finished. Conversation.abort() withdraws every queued input but keeps queued writes. Only a successful run applies the final boundary. A run that fails or is aborted settles its own inputs as unanswered and leaves the inbox alone.
nodes.zh: `Submission.abort()` 撤回一个仍在排队的提交项。它以 `unanswered` 落定，reason 为 `aborted`，调用返回 `"aborted"`。一旦 placed 就太晚了：调用返回 `"already_placed"`，如果已经结束则返回 `"settled"`。`Conversation.abort()` 撤回每一个排队的输入，但保留排队的写入。只有成功的运行才会应用 final 边界。失败或被中止的运行把自己的输入以 `unanswered` 落定，并不碰收件箱。

nodes.text: Queued follow-ups stay in the inbox, and their wait() does not resolve, until something else is submitted or you withdraw them. The next submission queues behind them, so the older follow-up runs first (test/harness-inbox.test.ts).
nodes.zh: 排队的 follow-up 会留在收件箱里，它们的 `wait()` 也不会兑现，直到有别的东西被提交或者你撤回它们。下一次提交会排在它们之后，于是更早的那个 follow-up 先运行（`test/harness-inbox.test.ts`）。

nodes.text: A crash changes none of this: every record and every inbox item is already committed. After reopening, a queued follow-up still runs once the interrupted run finishes. Only the in-memory waiters are lost. Get a new handle with harness.submission(id) and wait on that. Details: writes that move the head A write can set a head, which moves where the model’s context starts (reset, handoff and heads (p. 46)). A head that points earlier than the current start would bring back history that a reset or summary cut. Such a write is stale: it settles unanswered with reason stale, whether it was submitted while idle or reached a boundary. A reset (head: "self") is never stale. If a postTools boundary takes a reset, it acts as a final boundary, and the current run’s inputs settle with reason reset, because their context was cut before an answer. Compaction relies on the same rule (compaction (p. 97)).
nodes.zh: 崩溃不改变这一切：每条记录和每个收件箱项都已经提交。重新打开后，排队的 follow-up 在被中断的运行结束时仍会运行。只有内存里的等待者丢失了。用 `harness.submission(id)` 取一个新句柄，在它上面等待。详解：会移动头指针的写入 一次写入可以设置头指针，它决定模型的上下文从哪里开始（重置、交接与头指针（p. 46））。一个指向早于当前起点的头指针，会把已被重置或摘要切断的历史带回来。这样的写入是 stale 的：无论它是在空闲时提交的，还是抵达了某个边界，都以 `unanswered` 落定，reason 为 `stale`。重置（`head: "self"`）永远不是 stale。如果一个 `postTools` 边界取到一次重置，它就当作 final 边界，而当前运行的输入以 reason `reset` 落定，因为它们的上下文在答案之前就被切断了。压缩依赖的是同一条规则（压缩（p. 97））。

nodes.text: Pass a requestId on any submit you might retry. Pick whenBusy per message: steer for a correction the agent should see mid-run, followUp for the next question, reject when your UI should refuse. After a failed run, resubmit or withdraw queued follow-ups; do not wait on them forever. After a restart, get handles back with harness.submission(id).
nodes.zh: 任何你可能重试的 `submit()` 都带上 `requestId`。按消息选择 `whenBusy`：要让智能体在运行中途看到纠正用 `steer`，下一个问题用 `followUp`，界面该拒绝时用 `reject`。运行失败后，重新提交或撤回排队的 follow-up；不要永远等它们。重启之后，用 `harness.submission(id)` 取回句柄。

nodes.text: While an agent works, two questions matter. Is the conversation busy? And what should the screen show right now: the half-written answer, the tool’s scrolling output? Both answers live in one document, pi.live. It is committed like everything else, so a UI that connects late, or a process that restarts, sees the same picture. After this section you can read pi.live and say whether the conversation is busy, what the user sees, and what a crash loses.
nodes.zh: 智能体工作时，有两个问题要紧。会话是否繁忙？以及屏幕上此刻该显示什么：写了一半的答案，还是工具滚动的输出？两个答案都在同一个文档 `pi.live` 里。它和其他一切一样被提交，所以晚连接的界面，或者重启的进程，看到的是同一幅画面。读完本节，你就能读 `pi.live` 并说出会话是否繁忙、用户看到什么，以及崩溃会丢失什么。

nodes.text: Run control: the busy flag
nodes.zh: 运行控制：busy 标志

nodes.text: run is the lock. The conversation is busy exactly while run is present, and submit() checks nothing else (submissions (p. 84)). inputs lists the submissions this run will answer. taskId names the generation, the task making the current model call, that is responsible for answering them (generation (p. 91)). A run is a chain of generations, one per turn. Between turns the lock is handed over, never released: the old generation creates the next one and rewrites taskId in the same commit. A steer that lands at that moment is appended to inputs. When the run ends, one commit settles every listed input and deletes run, generation and tools.
nodes.zh: `run` 就是那把锁。只要 `run` 存在，会话就恰好是繁忙的，`submit()` 不检查别的（提交项（p. 84））。`inputs` 列出这次运行将要回答的提交项。`taskId` 指出负责回答它们的生成，也就是发起当前模型调用的那个任务（生成（p. 91））。一次运行是一条生成的链，每个轮次一条。轮次之间锁是移交，而不是释放：旧的生成创建下一个生成，并在同一次提交里改写 `taskId`。在那一刻落地的 steer 会被追加到 `inputs`。运行结束时，一次提交让列出的每个输入落定，并删除 `run`、`generation` 和 `tools`。

nodes.text: Live progress, and what it costs
nodes.zh: 实时进展，及其代价

nodes.text: generation and tools exist so a UI can show the answer and the tool output as they form. They are ordinary committed state, published like any other document (the conversation view (p. 129)). Every update is a commit, so updates are throttled. settings.progress has two intervals, both 100 ms by default: partialIntervalMs — how often the streaming answer is committed. In the capture, the first partial lands 103 ms after the request starts.
nodes.zh: `generation` 和 `tools` 的存在，是为了让界面能展示答案和工具输出形成的过程。它们就是普通的已提交状态，像任何其他文档一样发布（会话视图（p. 129））。每次更新都是一次提交，所以更新被节流。`settings.progress` 有两个间隔，默认都是 100 ms：`partialIntervalMs`——流式答案多久提交一次。在那次抓取中，第一个分片在请求开始后 103 ms 落地。

nodes.text: outputIntervalMs — how often tool output is committed. The first line after a quiet spell is committed at once; later writes are spaced at least one interval apart, and further apart when the output is large.
nodes.zh: `outputIntervalMs`——工具输出多久提交一次。安静一阵之后的第一行会立即提交；随后的写入至少间隔一个间隔，输出越大就隔得越开。

nodes.text: A host with remote storage can raise both intervals and show progress in larger steps. The document stays small: whenever nothing is running, it is stored as a complete snapshot, so its change history never grows past one model call or one round of tools (bases and deltas (p. 56)).
nodes.zh: 用远程存储的宿主可以调高这两个间隔，用更大的步长展示进展。这个文档始终很小：只要没有东西在运行，它就作为一份完整快照存储，所以它的变更历史不会超过一次模型调用或一轮工具（基线与增量（p. 56））。

nodes.text: What a crash leaves
nodes.zh: 崩溃留下什么

nodes.text: A crash loses answer text or tool output that was not yet committed. The gap since the last successful commit can exceed the configured progress interval. In the crash capture the process was killed about 50 ms after its last output commit, so the deploy slot still holds all six lines it had printed.
nodes.zh: 崩溃会丢失尚未提交的答案文本或工具输出。自上一次成功提交以来的间隔可以超过配置的进展间隔。在那次崩溃抓取中，进程在最后一次输出提交后约 50 ms 被杀死，所以 deploy 那个槽位仍然保留着它打印过的全部六行。

nodes.text: Recovery turns this progress into transcript, never into silence. A committed partial answer becomes an aborted assistant entry, so the transcript and UI retain what it had started to say. Later model requests exclude that aborted answer. A running tool’s committed output becomes the body of an interrupted result, or is cleared before a safe rerun (tool calls and replay (p. 94)).

nodes.text: 6 . 3 Generation

nodes.text: Each model call saves its model, options and transcript cutoff before sending. Recovery rebuilds that context and runs request hooks again.
nodes.zh: 每次模型调用在发出之前都保存自己的模型、选项和记录截止点。恢复会重建那份上下文，并再次运行请求钩子。

nodes.text: Calling the model is the slow, costly, failure-prone step of an agent. The provider may return a 503, the context may be too long, or the process may die mid-stream. Pi Durable runs each model call as a durable task called a generation. It commits the model, options and transcript cutoff. After a crash it rebuilds the request from those records, then reruns request hooks. After this section you can follow a model call through its phases, read its retry state, and say what a crash in each phase costs.
nodes.zh: 调用模型是智能体中缓慢、昂贵且容易失败的一步。供应商可能返回 503，上下文可能太长，进程也可能在流式输出中途死去。Pi Durable 把每次模型调用作为一个持久任务运行，称为一次生成。它提交模型、选项和记录截止点。崩溃之后，它从这些记录重建请求，然后重新运行请求钩子。读完本节，你就能跟随一次模型调用走过它的各个阶段，读出它的重试状态，并说出每个阶段崩溃的代价。

nodes.text: One generation, one turn
nodes.zh: 一次生成，一个轮次

nodes.text: A generation is a pi.generation task (phases and steps (p. 67)). It makes one model call, decides what happens next, and owns the tool calls of its turn. A run is a chain of generations passing run control from one to the next (run control (p. 88)).
nodes.zh: 一次生成是一个 `pi.generation` 任务（阶段与步骤（p. 67））。它发起一次模型调用，决定接下来发生什么，并拥有自己轮次里的工具调用。一次运行是一条生成的链，把运行控制从一次传给下一次（运行控制（p. 88））。

nodes.text: Prepare, then send
nodes.zh: 先准备，再发送

nodes.text: prepare reads the conversation’s agent and settings (the per-conversation agent (p. 106)). Without a usable model the run fails with reason no_model. It renders the system prompt (the system prompt (p. 115)) and checks whether the context needs compacting first (compaction (p. 97)). Then one commit moves to request and pins the model, options and transcript cutoff. cutoff is the newest transcript entry the request includes. Recovery rebuilds the committed context through cutoff, with the saved model and options. It then reruns beforeRequest hooks: their message replacements are not saved and can change on replay. A changed agent’s model and options apply from the next prepare, which every retry passes through. request builds the messages, lets beforeRequest hooks adjust them (hooks (p. 109)), and streams the response. The partial answer is committed on the throttle of the live document (p. 88). Each request carries a sessionId: one ID per conversation, kept in the built-in pi.provider document. Providers use it for prompt caching. It survives restarts, retries, resets and model changes; a fork gets a new one.
nodes.zh: `prepare` 读取会话的 agent 和 settings（每会话的 agent（p. 106））。没有可用模型时，运行以 reason `no_model` 失败。它渲染系统提示词（系统提示词（p. 115）），并检查上下文是否需要先压缩（压缩（p. 97））。然后一次提交进入 `request`，并钉住模型、选项和记录 cutoff。`cutoff` 是请求所包含的最新记录条目。恢复会用保存下来的模型和选项，重建截至 `cutoff` 的已提交上下文。接着它重新运行 `beforeRequest` 钩子：它们对消息的替换不会被保存，在重放时可能改变。被改动过的 agent，其模型和选项从下一次 `prepare` 起生效，而每次重试都会经过 `prepare`。`request` 构建消息，让 `beforeRequest` 钩子调整它们（钩子（p. 109）），然后流式输出响应。分片答案按实时文档的节流提交（p. 88）。每个请求都带一个 `sessionId`：每个会话一个 ID，保存在内置的 `pi.provider` 文档里。供应商用它做提示词缓存。它能挺过重启、重试、重置和模型更换；分叉会拿到一个新的。

nodes.text: Every response is appended as a pi.assistant entry and its cost recorded (usage (p. 100)), failures included. Later requests leave failed and aborted messages out (transcript to context (p. 40)). The stop reason picks the next step.

6 . 4 Tool calls and replay
nodes.zh: 6.4 工具调用与重放

nodes.text: Every tool call commits its intent before it runs; after a crash, only a tool declared safe to repeat runs again, and every other one is reported as
nodes.zh: 每次工具调用在运行之前都提交它的意图；崩溃之后，只有被声明为可安全重复的工具才会再运行，其余每一个都被报告为

nodes.text: interrupted.
nodes.zh: `interrupted`。

nodes.text: Your agent calls a deploy tool, and the process is killed halfway through. On restart, should it deploy again? Running it twice could be a disaster; quietly forgetting it is just as bad. Pi Durable never guesses. It commits the fact that the call is about to run, and after a crash it reruns only tools you declared safe to repeat. Every other call is reported to the model as interrupted. After this section you can decide whether a tool should be replay: "safe" and predict what the model sees after a crash.
nodes.zh: 你的智能体调用了一个部署工具，进程在执行到一半时被杀死。重启之后，它该不该再部署一次？跑两次可能是灾难；悄悄忘掉它同样糟糕。Pi Durable 从不猜测。它提交「这次调用即将运行」这个事实，崩溃之后只重跑那些你声明为可安全重复的工具。其余每一次调用都作为 `interrupted` 报告给模型。读完本节，你就能判断一个工具该不该重放：`"safe"`，并预测崩溃之后模型看到什么。

nodes.text: One task per call
nodes.zh: 每次调用一个任务

nodes.text: Each tool call the model makes becomes its own pi.tool task, owned by the generation that received the call. The task has two phases.
nodes.zh: 模型发起的每次工具调用都成为自己的 `pi.tool` 任务，由收到这次调用的生成拥有。这个任务有两个阶段。

A call goes through these steps: 1. Find the tool by name and check the arguments against its schema. 2. Run the beforeTool hooks, which may block the call or change its arguments (hooks (p. 109)). 3. Commit the intent: phase execute, with the final arguments and the tool’s replay policy, "unsafe" unless the tool says
nodes.zh: 一次调用经过这些步骤：1. 按名字找到工具，并按它的 schema 检查参数。2. 运行 `beforeTool` 钩子，它们可以阻止这次调用或改变它的参数（钩子（p. 109））。3. 提交意图：阶段 `execute`，带上最终的参数和工具的重放策略，默认 `"unsafe"`

nodes.text: otherwise.
nodes.zh: ，除非工具另有说明。

nodes.text: 4. Run execute(), then the afterTool hooks. 5. Commit the result: one pi.tool-result entry, and the task ends. This is the effect sandwich of Part 5 (p. 70): intent, effect, outcome. A call that fails before step 3 never touches the outside world, so it gets an error result at once. Whatever happens, the run goes on with a result entry: the model sees the error and decides what to do.
nodes.zh: 4. 运行 `execute()`，然后运行 `afterTool` 钩子。5. 提交结果：一条 `pi.tool-result` 条目，任务结束。这就是第 5 部分的效果三明治（p. 70）：意图、效果、结果。在第 3 步之前失败的调用从未碰到外部世界，所以它立刻得到一个错误结果。无论发生了什么，运行都会带着一条结果条目继续：模型看到错误，并决定怎么做。

nodes.text: Replay after a crash
nodes.zh: 崩溃之后的重放

nodes.text: A tool task found in execute after a restart knows one thing: the effect may have started. The rule is simple. The tool runs again only when both the stored policy and the tool’s current policy are safe. Otherwise the task commits an interrupted error result, built from the output the tool had already reported, and does not run the tool. The capture runs two slow tools in two conversations, kills the process while both are printing, and resumes in a new process. deploy sets no replay, so it is unsafe; fetch_report declares replay: "safe".
nodes.zh: 重启之后，一个被发现处于 `execute` 的工具任务只知道一件事：效果可能已经开始。规则很简单。只有当保存的策略和工具当前的策略都安全时，工具才会再跑一次。否则该任务提交一条 `interrupted` 错误结果，它由工具已经报告过的输出构成，并且不运行工具。那次抓取让两个会话里的两个慢速工具同时运行，在两者都在打印时杀死进程，然后在新进程里恢复。`deploy` 没有设置重放，所以它是不安全的；`fetch_report` 声明 `replay: "safe"`。

nodes.text: Task 22 ends failed, and the run goes on: the next generation answers “Tool deploy FAILED”. In conversation 7, the safe tool first clears its old output, then runs all ten steps in the new process and completes with entry 28. Both inputs end done. Choosing a policy replay: "safe" is a promise that running the effect twice is harmless: a read, an idempotent write, or a write with an idempotency key the remote side honours (the effect sandwich (p. 70)). Anything else should stay unsafe and let the model an honest “may have partially run”. Three details make the rule stricter than it looks: Both policies — a tool changed to unsafe is not rerun, and neither is a call stored as unsafe whose tool later became safe. A missing tool — a tool no longer available to the conversation counts as unsafe. A new environment — a rerun builds its environment again from the conversation’s current working directory, which may have changed (the execution environment (p. 155)).
nodes.zh: 任务 22 以 `failed` 结束，运行继续：下一个生成回答「Tool deploy FAILED」。在会话 7 里，安全的工具先清掉它旧的输出，然后在新进程中跑完十个步骤，以条目 28 完成。两个输入都以 `done` 结束。选择策略 `replay: "safe"` 是一个承诺：跑两次效果无害——一次读取、一次幂等写入，或者一次远端会遵守幂等键的写入（效果三明治（p. 70））。其他任何东西都该保持不安全，好让模型得到一句诚实的「可能只跑了一部分」。有三个细节让这条规则比看上去更严：两个策略都要看——一个被改成不安全的工具不会被重跑，一个存为不安全、而其工具后来变安全的调用同样不会被重跑。工具缺失——对该会话不再可用的工具算作不安全。新的环境——重跑会再次从会话当前的工作目录构建它的环境，而工作目录可能已经变了（执行环境（p. 155））。

nodes.text: A crash before step 3 is cheaper. The task is still in call, so the whole call runs once from the start, beforeTool included.
nodes.zh: 第 3 步之前的崩溃代价更小。任务仍处于 `call`，所以整个调用从头跑一次，`beforeTool` 也一样。

nodes.text: Tool rounds
nodes.zh: 工具轮

nodes.text: A tool round is all the calls in one model response. They run in parallel by default, and one failing call never cancels the others. The round runs one call at a time when settings.toolExecution is "sequential" or any called tool declares executionMode: "sequential". When every call has finished, the generation commits once. A tool result can steer that commit (defining tools (p. 112)):
nodes.zh: 工具轮就是一次模型响应里的全部调用。默认并行运行，一个失败的调用绝不会取消其他调用。当 `settings.toolExecution` 为 `"sequential"`，或任何被调用的工具声明了 `executionMode: "sequential"` 时，这一轮一次只跑一个调用。当每个调用都结束时，生成提交一次。一个工具结果可以引导那次提交（定义工具（p. 112））：

nodes.text: terminate — end the run without another model call, but only if every call in the round asks for it. handoff — reset the context to a handoff text and end the run (reset and handoff (p. 46)). addTools — offer more tools from the next turn. Otherwise a postTools boundary runs and a new generation takes the run. If the run is aborted mid-round, calls that never started get an aborted result. Details: the error results the Harness writes
nodes.zh: `terminate`——不再发起模型调用就结束运行，但只有当这一轮里每个调用都这么要求时。`handoff`——把上下文重置为一段交接文本并结束运行（重置与交接（p. 46））。`addTools`——从下一轮起提供更多工具。否则运行一次 `postTools` 边界，由一个新的生成接管这次运行。如果运行在轮中途被中止，从未开始的调用会得到一个 `aborted` 结果。详解：Harness 写入的错误结果

nodes.text: 6 . 5 Compaction
nodes.zh: 6.5 压缩

nodes.text: A compaction replaces the oldest part of what the model sees with a summary; nothing is deleted, and the summary that cuts furthest wins.
nodes.zh: 压缩用一段摘要替换模型所见内容中最老的那部分；什么都没有被删除，而切得最靠前的摘要胜出。

nodes.text: Long conversations outgrow the model’s context window. Compaction asks the model to summarize the oldest part, then sends the summary in its place. The full history stays in storage; only what the model sees gets shorter. After this section you can set the token budgets, tell which compactions make a run wait, and predict which of two competing summaries wins.
nodes.zh: 长会话会超出模型的上下文窗口。压缩让模型总结最老的那部分，然后代之以这段摘要发送。完整历史仍留在存储里；只有模型看到的东西变短了。读完本节，你就能设定 token 预算、分辨哪些压缩会让一次运行等待，并预测两个互相竞争的摘要中哪一个胜出。

nodes.text: What a compaction writes
nodes.zh: 压缩写下什么

nodes.text: A compaction is a pi.compaction task. It picks a prefix of the context, asks the model to summarize it, and adds one summary entry. The entry’s head is the first entry kept word for word, so the model’s context now starts at the summary and continues from there (heads (p. 46)). In this capture, compact() ran after three answered questions, while a fourth answer was being written.
nodes.zh: 一次压缩是一个 `pi.compaction` 任务。它挑出上下文的一个前缀，让模型总结它，并加入一条摘要条目。该条目的头指针是第一条逐字保留的条目，于是模型的上下文现在从摘要开始，从那里继续（头指针（p. 46））。在这次抓取中，`compact()` 在三个问题都回答完之后运行，而第四个答案正在被写入。

nodes.zh: 摘要文本被折成三行；时间戳和 `conversationId` 被省略。会话当时繁忙，所以摘要作为写入提交项 `compaction:22` 在收件箱里等待，而正在运行的生成（任务 21）把它 placed 了。

nodes.text: Three ways to start one
nodes.zh: 三种启动方式

nodes.text: The last column is a safety rule. A running generation must not have its transcript change under it. A blocking compaction may append directly because its own generation is the one waiting for it. Every other summary is submitted like any write and lands at the next boundary, or at once if the conversation is idle (submissions (p. 84)). A non-blocking compaction never makes the conversation busy; it shows in pi.live.compactions while it runs.
nodes.zh: 最后一列是一条安全规则。一个正在运行的 generation 不能眼看着自己的记录在脚下被改动。阻塞式压缩可以直接追加，因为等待它的正是它自己的生成。其他任何摘要都像任何写入一样被提交，在下一个边界落地；如果会话空闲，则立即落地（提交项（p. 84））。非阻塞压缩绝不会让会话变繁忙；它运行时显示在 `pi.live.compactions` 里。

nodes.text: When generation compacts
nodes.zh: 生成何时压缩

nodes.text: In prepare, generation estimates the size of the request it is about to send and compares it with two budgets from settings.compaction.
nodes.zh: 在 `prepare` 里，生成估算它即将发出的请求有多大，并把它与 `settings.compaction` 的两个预算比较。

nodes.text: Two budgets decide when generation compacts; keepRecentTokens decides where the cut falls. Numbers from ex 25, a test model with a 3000-token window. The defaults are reserveTokens 16384, backgroundTokens 32768 and keepRecentTokens 20000. The lower row is schematic: counting back lands in a tool result, so the cut moves to the next message and fewer than 400 tokens stay.

Blocking — above contextWindow − reserveTokens, generation starts a compaction and waits for it, then prepares again and sends the request whatever the outcome. Background — above that line minus backgroundTokens, generation starts a compaction in the background and sends the request without waiting. backgroundTokens: 0 turns this off. The cut is chosen by counting back from the newest entry until keepRecentTokens are kept. It then lands on the next user or assistant message, never on a tool result, so a kept assistant message keeps its tool results. If the whole context is smaller than keepRecentTokens, nothing is compacted. A too-long context gets one rescue. When the provider rejects a request as too long, generation compacts and prepares the same attempt again. A generation compacts at most once, so a second overflow fails the run with model_error. Run 25 shows this: its last turn compacts on the blocking budget, then hits an overflow and fails.
nodes.zh: 阻塞——超过 `contextWindow − reserveTokens` 时，生成启动一次压缩并等待它，然后重新准备，无论结果如何都发出请求。背景——超过那条线减去 `backgroundTokens` 时，生成在后台启动一次压缩，不等待就发出请求。`backgroundTokens: 0` 会关掉这一项。切口是从最新条目往回数，直到保住 `keepRecentTokens` 为止。然后它落在下一条用户或助手消息上，绝不落在工具结果上，于是被保留的助手消息保留了它的工具结果。如果整个上下文小于 `keepRecentTokens`，就什么都不压缩。上下文太长有且只有一次补救。当供应商以太长为由拒绝一个请求时，生成压缩一次，并以同一个 attempt 重新准备。一次生成最多压缩一次，所以第二次溢出会让运行以 `model_error` 失败。run 25 展示了这一点：它最后一个轮次在阻塞预算上压缩，随后撞上溢出并失败。

nodes.text: When summaries compete
nodes.zh: 当摘要互相竞争

nodes.text: Compactions never coordinate; several can run at once. The stale-head rule of the inbox (p. 84) alone picks the winner. A summary whose cut is older than the context’s current start settles stale. One that cuts at or after it is placed, whenever it started.
nodes.zh: 压缩之间从不协调；好几个可以同时运行。唯有收件箱的 stale 头指针规则（p. 84）决定胜者。切口早于上下文当前起点的摘要以 `stale` 落定。切口在其处或之后的摘要则被 placed，无论它是什么时候开始的。

nodes.text: Details The summary request — no tools, the transcript with tool results cut to 2000 characters, and any extra instructions you passed to compact(). Only a clean stop with text counts as a summary. Retryable errors retry under settings.retry. A beforeCompact hook can decline the compaction or supply its own summary (hooks (p. 109)). Aborting — Conversation.abort() (the Esc key) aborts a manual compaction. A background compaction keeps going unless you pass { background: true } or call abortTask(). A blocking one stops with its generation. Edits during compaction — an app edit or head placed while a compaction runs can be lost or undone when the summary lands spec §12.
nodes.zh: 详解 摘要请求——不带工具，记录里的工具结果被截到 2000 字符，以及你传给 `compact()` 的任何额外指令。只有带文本的干净停止才算一次摘要。可重试的错误按 `settings.retry` 重试。`beforeCompact` 钩子可以拒绝这次压缩，或给出自己的摘要（钩子（p. 109））。中止——`Conversation.abort()`（Esc 键）会中止一次手动压缩。后台压缩会继续下去，除非你传入 `{ background: true }` 或调用 `abortTask()`。阻塞式压缩随它的生成一起停下。压缩期间的编辑——压缩运行时插入的应用内编辑或头指针，可能在摘要落地时丢失或被撤销。spec §12。

nodes.text: The defaults suit large windows. For a small window, keep keepRecentTokens well below the blocking line, or the context can overflow before anything is compacted. Call compact() any time; it never blocks the run. Place app edits before compacting, not during. Every summary attempt is paid for, even one that ends stale.
nodes.zh: 这些默认值适合大窗口。对于小窗口，要让 `keepRecentTokens` 远低于阻塞线，否则上下文可能在任何压缩发生之前就溢出。任何时候都可以调用 `compact()`；它从不阻塞运行。把应用内编辑放在压缩之前，而不是压缩之中。每一次摘要尝试都要付费，即使它最终以 stale 结束。

6 . 6 Usage and cost
nodes.zh: 6.6 用量与成本

nodes.text: Spend is recorded in the same commit as the response that caused it, so the ledger and the transcript can never disagree.
nodes.zh: 开销与导致它的那次响应记录在同一次提交里，所以账本和记录永远不会不一致。

nodes.text: How much has this conversation cost so far? pi.usage answers it. The ledger is updated in the same commit as each model response, so it matches the transcript exactly, even after a crash. After this section you can read the ledger, say which attempts it counts, and total spend across conversations without counting anything twice.
nodes.zh: 到目前为止这次会话花了多少？`pi.usage` 给出答案。账本与每次模型响应在同一次提交里更新，所以即使崩溃之后它也与记录完全吻合。读完本节，你就能读账本、说出它计的是哪些尝试，并在不重复计算任何东西的前提下汇总多个会话的开销。

nodes.text: The ledger
nodes.zh: 账本

nodes.text: pi.usage is a built-in document, one per conversation, with two maps. models is keyed by "provider/model". tools is keyed by tool name, for tools that pay for their own model calls. Each value is a pi-ai Usage record, the same shape every assistant message carries. A fork starts at zero.
nodes.zh: `pi.usage` 是一个内置文档，每个会话一个，包含两个映射。`models` 以 `"provider/model"` 为键。`tools` 以工具名为键，用于那些为自己的模型调用付费的工具。每个值都是一条 `pi-ai` 的 `Usage` 记录，与每条助手消息携带的形状相同。分叉从零开始。

nodes.text: pi.usage after one tool call and one answer research/capture/extra-p6/live-run.txt JSON
nodes.zh: 一次工具调用和一次回答之后的 `pi.usage` `research/capture/extra-p6/live-run.txt` `JSON`

nodes.text: The sum of two responses: the tool-calling one (118 tokens) and the final answer. The test provider reports zero cost.
nodes.zh: 两次响应之和：调用工具的那一次（118 token）和最终答案。测试供应商报告的成本为零。

nodes.text: Token counts — input, output, cacheRead, cacheWrite and totalTokens, always present. Optional counts — cacheWrite1h (cache writes with one-hour retention) and reasoning (output spent thinking), when the provider reports them. cost — the same buckets plus total, priced by pi-ai for the model. The ledger is a running sum. Per-turn spend is still in the transcript: each assistant entry carries its own usage.
nodes.zh: token 计数——`input`、`output`、`cacheRead`、`cacheWrite` 和 `totalTokens`，始终存在。可选计数——`cacheWrite1h`（保留一小时有效期的缓存写入）和 `reasoning`（花在思考上的输出），取决于供应商是否报告。`cost`——相同的分桶再加上 `total`，由 `pi-ai` 按该模型定价。账本是一个累计和。逐轮的开销仍然在记录里：每个助手条目都带着自己的用量。

nodes.text: What gets counted
nodes.zh: 什么会被计入

nodes.text: Usage is recorded in the commit that appends the response, never later.
nodes.zh: 用量记录在追加该响应的那次提交里，绝不在之后。

nodes.text: Failed and aborted attempts count, because the provider charged for them. An attempt cut off before anything was committed has no response, so nothing is counted for it; the resend is counted when it answers.
nodes.zh: 失败和被中止的尝试也计入，因为供应商已经为此收了费。在任何东西提交之前就被切断的尝试没有响应，所以什么都不计入；重发在给出答案时才计入。

nodes.text: Each conversation counts only its own spend. harness.usage() adds up every conversation’s ledger into one total; nothing stores that total. For other totals, such as one subagent tree, sum the ledgers yourself over scanConversations().

nodes.text: A tool that runs a subagent in its own conversation must not report that conversation’s spend in its result’s usage. The child’s pi.usage already counts it, so harness.usage() would count it twice (subagents (p. 121)).
nodes.zh: 在自有会话中运行子智能体的工具，不应在结果的 `usage` 里报告那个会话的开销。子会话的 `pi.usage` 已经计了它，所以 `harness.usage()` 会算两次（子智能体（p. 121））。

nodes.text: A UI reads the ledger like any other document, through the conversation view’s docs["pi.usage"] (the conversation view (p. 129)).
nodes.zh: 界面像读任何其他文档一样读这个账本，走会话视图的 `docs["pi.usage"]`（会话视图（p. 129））。

nodes.text: Read per-conversation spend from pi.usage, and the grand total from harness.usage(). Report tool usage only for spend the tool paid for directly. Tool names are data: read the maps with Object.entries(), not property access, in case a tool is named __proto__.
nodes.zh: 逐会话的开销从 `pi.usage` 读，总计从 `harness.usage()` 读。只报告工具直接付费的那部分开销。工具名是数据：用 `Object.entries()` 读这些映射，不要用属性访问，以防某个工具名叫 `__proto__`。
